item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: Launchy 2026.9.0
item.description:
Open Source Launchpad Alternative

Launchy is an open source Launchpad alternative that provides a long-awaited solution for macOS users. The app features a full-screen mode that mimics the classic Launchpad experience and adds a wealth of control options. At the same time, Floaty mode acts as a HUD, allowing users to keep the feel of the new macOS design by quickly switching without changing how they want to operate. Launchy quickly scans apps and caches icons to ensure you always have a responsive mesh in every space, for free. Its key features include a full-screen experience, powerful mesh features, context-aware control, hot corner activation, automatic updates, etc. It also supports fast input, keyboard shortcut manipulation, and gesture control, enabling users to efficiently manage and launch applications. The app is licensed under an mit license, ensuring it is always free, and plans to release more enhancements in the future. Improve your experience with free downloads and automatic updates. Launchy is an open source Launchpad alternative that gives macOS users the full experience they've been waiting for.

item.title: Double Commander 1.2.10
item.description:
Open source two-panel file management tool

Double Commander is a free, cross-platform, open-source file manager that uses a classic two-column interface design to display two file panels side by side and support up and down arrangement, making it easy for users to browse, compare, and manage files in different directories at the same time. Inspired by Total Commander, the software adds its own design ideas while retaining the habit of working with two-panel files, and is suitable for users who need to organize files efficiently, move content between multiple locations, or perform daily directory management. Double Commander supports multiple platforms and operating systems, and is compatible with 32-bit and 64-bit processors, covering different hardware environments. The project is governed by GPL-2. 0 The license is continuously developed. The source code, build scripts, plug-ins, language files and help documents can be viewed in the public repository. Users can select the corresponding version according to their own system and obtain the latest version information through the project release page. Double Commander is an open source file management tool for multi-platform environments, with a two-column file panel as the core, providing a clear and intuitive way to manage directories, suitable for file browsing, organizing and cross-directory operations.

item.title: Adrafinil 1.14.0
item.description:
Wake On Mac Tool for AI Agents

Adrafinil is a menu bar resident tool for macOS. It is designed for users who need to run AI programming agents for a long time. It can keep the Mac awake during the task execution of Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Devin, Aider, Hermes, OpenCode, Cline, Pi and other agents. Even if the display is closed, it can continue to work and automatically release and keep awake after the task is over. The software keeps track of different agents and sessions through the hook mechanism, supports multiple agents to run at the same time, get and release by session, keep awake at regular intervals, and manually put the system to sleep. It also provides command-line and MCP access, facilitates access to custom workflows, and implements lid-closing operation control through a privileged auxiliary program. For unattended scenarios, Adrafinil has built-in temperature protection, automatic cleaning of abandoned sessions, and a wake-up timeout mechanism to reduce the risk of equipment running for a long time. At the same time, Adrafinil supports proxy process detection, lid closure audio confirmation, activity and temperature summary after lid opening, and removal of relevant hooks during uninstallation.

item.title: MountMate 6.4
item.description:
macOS External Hard Disk Management Tool

MountMate is a native menu bar external hard drive management tool for macOS that is suitable for users who often connect to a mobile hard drive, desktop hard drive, or other external storage device. Without opening Disk Utility or launching the terminal, users can quickly mount and unmount connected hard disks from the menu bar, view the current connected devices, mount status, and available storage space, and confirm the remaining capacity before copying large files. For Mac mini, Mac Studio users who have long connected an external hard drive, MountMate can help reduce unnecessary background waking, hard drive spinning, noise, and additional wear and tear, allowing storage devices to run only when needed. The software is built using the macOS system API, and the interface is integrated into the system menu bar. After installation, it can be used without complex configuration; All status information is processed locally, does not require an account, does not contain analytics, telemetry, or network requests, and is suitable for users who value privacy and system simplicity. MountMate is open source at the same time, making it easy for users to understand project implementation, feedback issues, and participate in improvements.

item.title: SystemEQ for Mac 1.4.8
item.description:
The menu bar controls global audio equalization

SystemEQ for Mac is an open source global parameter equalizer for macOS 13 and above. It supports Apple Silicon and Intel Mac, and can adjust the sound for the system audio output of Spotify, YouTube, Apple Music and other applications. The software provides 10-band and 31-band equalization modes, combined with dual second-order filters, pre-gain control, and automatic clipping protection to facilitate modification of frequency responses, enhancement of low frequencies, or suppression of harsh bands. The built-in AutoEQ database contains 8665 headphone models and 8,850 presets, supporting offline search, fast import, and low-frequency enhancement adjustments. The Hearing Calibration Module provides 31 frequencies of testing, custom configurations, and A/B contrast, and the Subjective Room Tuning and Resonance Finder helps locate roar or ringing frequencies through auditory and sinusoidal scanning. macOS 14. 4 and above can use native audio capture, older systems or fallback scenarios are routed through BlackHole.

item.title: Cherry Studio 2.1.10
item.description:
Customize your own AI assistant

Cherry Studio is a Windows, Mac, and Linux-compatible desktop client that supports multiple major language model (LLM) providers. It not only integrates cloud services such as OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, but also supports the deployment of Ollama and LM Studio native models. Users can use the built-in 300 + preconfigured AI assistants, or custom create a dedicated assistant to talk to multiple models at the same time and get diverse perspectives. At the same time, the app supports a variety of document formats, including text, pictures, Office, and PDF, with WebDAV file management and data backup capabilities. Cherry Studio also provides useful tools such as global search, topic management, AI-driven translation, and ensures a quality experience with light and dark themes and transparent windows that can be used out of the box without additional configuration. Users who like Cherry Studio can support its development through Little Star or sponsored developers.

item.title: FanBar 0.7.3
item.description:
Mac Fan Control Tool

FanBar is a native macOS menu bar temperature monitoring and fan control tool that supports macOS 11 Big Sur and later for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs that can provide readable fan data via AppleSMC. The software displays the CPU temperature, average fan speed, or a combination of the two in the menu bar, and presents the temperature change through a scrolling chart for the last ten minutes, reading the GPU, SSD, and battery temperature when the hardware supports it. Everyday use keeps macOS under automatic thermal management, and after approving a signed control service, you can set a fixed speed, or choose mute, equalize, performance, and extreme thermal presets. Each preset has an independently editable temperature and speed curve that supports CPU, GPU or SSD temperature as the basis for adjustment, and can also restore system control after a specified time. The software provides protection against high-temperature notifications, hardware rpm limits, and attempts to restore automatic control in the event of an abnormality. macOS 14 and later also adds a desktop widget to view the heat dissipation status, and the widget refresh is scheduled by the system.

item.title: LuLu 4.5.5
item.description:
Open-source lightweight firewall for macOS

LuLu is a free, open-source macOS firewall that blocks unknown outgoing connections until you explicitly approve them. It detects and stops unauthorized network connections, helping prevent malware and third-party apps from sending data to remote servers. Its design is simple and easy to use, with a small attack surface, and its source code is public on GitHub for transparency. It supports single-user installs and currently focuses on process-level network rules. It provides basic network monitoring rather than full self-protection, so determined targeted attacks may still bypass it.

item.title: OnlySwitch release_3.3.0
item.description:
Menu Bar System Switches Collection

OnlySwitch is a powerful macOS menu bar application that provides a series of switches designed to simplify the user's daily workflow, such as hiding desktop icons, switching dark mode, and hiding the grooves of the new MacBook Pro. The user can easily control these functions in the status bar, and the displayed switches and shortcuts can be customized as needed. Since version 1. As of 7, users can import custom shortcuts into OnlySwitch and support keyboard shortcuts from version 2.0. The app also supports Apple widgets, which allow users to place relevant switches and buttons on their desktops or notification centers for quick and easy access. OnlySwitch supports switching between various macOS browsers, keeping users' browsing history and allowing users to add or remove features based on their needs. The software comes with a 30-day free trial and can be installed via Homebrew or downloaded manually. OnlySwitch is a powerful menu bar app designed to streamline users' daily workflows, such as hiding desktop icons, switching between dark modes, and hiding the bangs of the new MacBook Pro.

item.title: GitHub Stars Manager 0.8.9
item.description:
GitHub Repository Stars Admin Tool

GithubStarsManager is a cross-platform GitHub resource management tool for developers that centralizes Stars, Forks, and Gists to transform scattered collection content into a searchable, categorizable, and traceable personal knowledge base. The software uses AI to analyze the README, documents, submission records and code structure of the warehouse, automatically generates summaries, tags and platform information, and establishes a clear technical data system through 14 categories of preset classification and custom classification. Natural language search, vector semantic search, and AI rearrangement can help users locate repositories by intention, and the repository Q&A assistant provides source-based answers based on README, submissions, and Issues. Users can also track version releases, identify platform download links, sync forks, trigger GitHub Actions, manage Gists, and browse trending items.

item.title: Motrix 2.2.0
item.description:
Multi-Protocol Resource Download Tool

Motrix for Mac is an all-around download tool. Support HTTP download, FTP download, BT download, magnetic link download, Baidu net disk resource download. Motrix also uses "Aria 2" as the core, so the download speed, multi-threading and other capabilities are almost the same as other download tools.

item.title: OrbitRing 1.6.8
item.description:
Ring Launcher App Quick Toggle Tool

OrbitRing is a simple and intuitive macOS app launcher with a unique circular design that provides users with a quick way to access the app, significantly improving productivity. With its sleek and lightweight features, OrbitRing arranges apps around the mouse for a natural and smooth experience. It's fast and efficient, gives users easy access to the apps they need, and has a variety of personalization options to perfectly fit their usage habits. OrbitRing is lightweight in resource usage and integrates seamlessly with macOS, providing the ideal tool to increase user productivity. OrbitRing is a simple and intuitive macOS app launcher with a unique circular design that enables fast access to apps and significantly improves user productivity. Its unique ring layout provides quick access to the app around the mouse, giving users a smooth and natural launch experience. Easy and efficient: With a circular layout around the mouse, users can easily access the apps they need for quick launches and actions.

item.title: Widgetify 4.55
item.description:
Personalized desktop design tools

Widgetify is a desktop personalization tool designed for macOS that provides a rich set of highly customizable widgets that allow users to design their desktop to their liking, making it a place to remind themselves of important people, places, and words. With Widgetify, users can showcase their personal photos, count down to upcoming events, keep popular app shortcuts on desktop, see the weather at a glance, and more. Each widget can be precisely tuned to match the look and functionality users expect, including a wide selection of colors, backgrounds, sizes, and themes. Widgetify enables users to create and easily change the perfect desktop wall look over time. These include popular widgets such as photo browsing, music playback status controls (with support for Spotify, Apple Music, and lyrics), custom date and time clocks, app shortcuts and folder organizers, Day Master, to-dos and notes, weather conditions and forecasts, time zone tracking, and statistics and page turn clocks. Widgetify is software that lets you personalize your desktop like never before, offering a wide range of highly customizable widgets.

item.title: Netutilus 1.21.0
item.description:
macOS Web Toolkit

Netutilus: Network Utility is a professional network diagnostic tool designed for Mac that integrates 8 classic and powerful network utilities to help users easily troubleshoot network problems, monitor connection status, and perform advanced diagnostics. Netutilus retains all the benefits of the traditional macOS networking tools that users love, while being fully upgraded with a modern interface design and added power. It provides TCP-based ping testing with real-time latency charts and detailed statistics; supports Traceroute and visual Traceroute (Gold Tier) to track packet paths by hop or view routing information on an interactive world map; built-in speed testing to measure downloads, uplinks, latency and jitter using Cloudflare's global network; DNS query supports custom DNS servers, querying A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, SOA, PTR and other record types;

item.title: IPTV Expert 11.6.2
item.description:
IPTV Network Streaming Player

IPTV Expert is the ultimate IPTV player designed for a seamless streaming experience, freeing users from dissatisfaction. It supports all IPTV service providers and media content and is loved by thousands of users. IPTV Expert ensures a seamless viewing experience on the go with easy playlist importing, great automatic categorization, Chromecast support, Electronic Program Guide (EPG), offline viewing, replay functionality, subtitle support, and multi-account management. Its beautiful user interface, series browsing features, and picture-in-picture support further enhance the ease and fun of use, resulting in a high-quality streaming experience. Upgrade your viewing experience with IPTV Expert! Tired of unsatisfactory IPTV players? Meet IPTV Expert, the ultimate IPTV player designed for exceptional performance. Loved and trusted by thousands of users, IPTV Expert supports all IPTV providers and media content for unparalleled viewing pleasure.

item.title: Pinning 2.1
item.description:
Life Story Recording Tool

Pinning – Countdown Events is a powerful countdown and event management app that combines a simple calendar viewer to help users record life stories and track project milestones. Users can easily create a variety of events and organize them in a notebook with a dedicated list of birthdays and anniversaries built in, so important days can be seen at a glance. Events are presented as timelines with support for custom icons or emojis that highlight the countdown or positive timing. The app provides beautiful homepage widgets and lock screen widgets to keep your most important events on your desktop or lock screen for easy viewing at any time. Pinning supports iCloud collaboration for sharing important events with family and friends, as well as syncing upcoming calendar events and scheduled reminders. Users can create recurring events and set notification reminders, use Siri shortcuts to quickly save a single event or event list as a picture, or even import data from a birthday calendar or create a new event from a calendar. Whether tracking birthdays, anniversaries, or managing day-to-day tasks and long-term projects, Pinning delivers the ultimate experience in elegant design and seamless operation for users seeking efficient living records and event planning.

item.title: Metion 3.9.8
item.description:
Tools to Improve Writing Efficiency

Metion is a note-taking tool focused on the writing experience, with Markdown as the basic text syntax. Metion 2.0 introduces a new feature called Knowledge Base that allows users to build their own knowledge base by converting plain text syntax into mind map trees or network connections. We make the writing experience a top priority, especially on iPadOS, although it's not easy. Metion supports full keyboard shortcuts, which significantly improves the writing experience for iPad and iPhone when connected to a keyboard. At the same time, we redesigned the "Zen mode" on the iPad to provide a more focused writing environment, where users can choose the right background image and favorite white noise, hide irrelevant UI elements, and make the writing process pleasant and focused. Metion is based on an open file system that eliminates the need to create new formats for data storage, articles exist as plain text files, pictures are stored in specific folders, a data free and open file system enables synchronization of data using iCloud or Git, and supports fast backups. In addition, Metion has a built-in Historical Versions feature that improves the reliability of your documents.

item.title: Vitals 1.9.2
item.description:
macOS Activity Monitor Alternative

Vitals is a system resource monitoring tool for macOS that can be used as an alternative to activity monitors in daily use, combining the statistics of applications and their auxiliary processes to visually present the CPU, memory, energy consumption, disk, and network occupancy of each application, helping to locate sources of stuttering, heating, and power consumption. The software supports custom menu bar readings and charts, saves local history for up to a year, and sends notifications when applications continue to experience high loads, memory growth, or disk and network activity anomalies. For development scenarios, Vitals organizes development servers and ports by project, marks idle services, displays Docker container resource usage, tracks programming agent sessions and their launched subprocesses, and provides information on AI program balance, reset time, and token usage. Built-in MCP services and command-line tools for Claude, Codex, Cursor, or script queries for system status. It also integrates independent application volume, temperature and fan, battery health, Bluetooth device power, GPU and neural network engine monitoring.

item.title: Multitouch 2.0.2
item.description:
macOS trackpad gesture control enhancement

Multitouch is a powerful gesture engine designed to easily add gestures to macOS, with support for a well-designed trackpad and magic mouse gestures, and a plethora of options for browsers, keyboard shortcuts, and click actions. The software has built-in best-in-class window management features, including Rectangle's keyboard shortcuts, menu items, and drag-and-drop alignment areas. In addition, users can convert a key to a superkey, click with a key, remap a button, or create a shortcut to execute a script. Multitouch supports the use of any trackpad or magic mouse on macOS 10.15 and above, and each license can be activated simultaneously on up to three devices. Multitouch is a powerful gesture engine designed to easily add multi-touch gestures to macOS with a well-designed trackpad and Magic Mouse gestures. The software provides rich operation options, including browser operations, keystrokes, mouse clicks, etc., to help users achieve efficient workflows.

item.title: Fluent 2.3.3
item.description:
Flexible AI writing tools

Fluent is a powerful AI writing assistant designed to improve the efficiency and quality of users' writing. It's as flexible as Spotlight and works in any app, helping users with translation, grammar corrections, drafting email and social media posts, extracting bullet points, and more. Fluent enables users to use their own cloud AI API keys, such as OpenAI, Gemini, and OpenRouter, and provides more than 320 OpenRouter models as well as a variety of on-premises AI models that can be loaded directly from the Mac for data security. Users can customize hotkeys and actions, use more than 30 preset default actions, and preview results in real time, including Markdown rendering, through the smart panel. Focused on privacy, Fluent does not collect user data, supports fully offline work, and is a tool designed to increase writing productivity. Fluent Mac is a powerful AI writing assistant designed to improve the efficiency and quality of your writing. It offers a variety of features, including translation, grammar correction, email, and social media post drafting, all seamlessly integrated into any app you're using.

item.title: TelunKey 2.1.13
item.description:
Mac Window Switcher

TelunKey is a native macOS keyboard window switching tool developed with Swift that integrates application activation and target window selection into a single keystroke operation for work scenarios that frequently switch between multiple applications, windows, and desktops. The software supports independent triggering of left and right Command and left and right Option, and can also be triggered using Space, which is convenient to configure the operation according to personal habits. After triggering, the actionable target is directly displayed, and the window keyboard layout is mapped to the key position area. The user can confirm the target by pressing the key, reducing the repeated switching between the application and the mouse to find the window. Especially suitable for Chrome multi-window browsing and the scene where a large number of windows work in parallel. TelunKey focuses on low latency response and lightweight background operation, reducing double counting and invalid wake-up by updating window information on demand and lightweight cache. Core data remains on-premises, with no behavioral analysis by default, and no reliance on cloud services. The software supports at least macOS 14.0 Sonoma, which can be installed and updated through Homebrew, and in-app check for updates;

item.title: ByteMail 1.9.9
item.description:
AI-enhanced native Mac email client

bytemail is a native Mac email client built with SwiftUI and AppKit, with no bundled browser engine. It supports Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, Microsoft 365, Yahoo, Fastmail and other IMAP accounts in one fast unified inbox. Features include conversation and classic views, instant cross-account and attachment search, smart labels, rule-based archiving, snooze, scheduled send, undo send, reminders and per-account signatures. It connects directly to your mail provider, keeps credentials in the macOS Keychain, and sends no mail, contacts or usage data through bytemail servers. Tracking pixels and tracking link parameters are stripped, and it flags spoofed domains and suspicious links. It also offers local summaries, smart replies and Rewrite, and connects to AI apps such as Claude, Codex and Cursor through MCP.

item.title: Caxton 2.2.1
item.description:
macOS Large File Editor

Caxton is a native large file editor for macOS that handles production logs, database export files, oversized CSV, JSON exports, and crash reports that are hard to open with a regular text editor. It uses Memory-mapped I/O, piece-table document model and hierarchical line indexing to fully open and index files up to 10GB and more than 80 million lines, while only rendering the current viewport content, so that ultra-long single-line compressed files can also be scrolled smoothly. The software provides log-following mode, full-text search, regular matching, batch replacement, multi-conditional filtering, original line number retention and large file segmentation opening functions; CSV mode supports automatic delimiter recognition, header freezing, type inference, million-level row and column sorting, cell editing, column splitting, merge extraction and deduplication. Built on AppKit and Swift, Caxton does not rely on Electron or web views, supports dark mode, tabs, native file dialogs, system services, and print capabilities. Files are left native by default, are not uploaded, are not processed in the cloud, and do not include telemetry.

item.title: Bloom 1.5.47
item.description:
Increase efficiency with multi-pane file management

Bloom is a productivity-enhancing alternative to Finder designed to provide users with a more streamlined and efficient file management experience. It has a number of powerful features, including a system-wide "Go to Folder" shortcut and keyword search capabilities, allowing users to quickly locate the files they need. Bloom's Portal window is designed to be compact and easy to use in multitasking, while allowing you to view the contents of a compressed file without decompressing it. The app also offers a variety of useful tools, including intelligent column width auto-adjustment, advanced renaming capabilities, iCloud Drive support, and easy folder manipulation. Bloom Mac is an improved Finder alternative designed to enhance user productivity and file management experience with powerful features and multi-pane layouts. It provides an intuitive way to search and manipulate files, enabling users to organize and access files more efficiently. Multi-pane layout: Bloom supports multi-pane layout, users can view and manage multiple folders at the same time, improve productivity. Quick search experience: With the shortcut ⌘ aves, users can quickly access the⇧ "Go to folder" function, which supports searching for files by keywords, and the search speed is extremely fast.

item.title: TabTab 2.2.3
item.description:
Quickly switch between windows and tabs

TabTab is a powerful window and tab management tool designed for Mac to increase user productivity. It supports Intel and Apple Silicon Macs and is compatible with macOS 14.0 and above, providing a fast and intuitive experience that runs entirely on your device. TabTab not only manages windows in all Mac apps, but also supports full-screen and split-screen views, allowing you to manage tabs within specific apps like Google Chrome, Safari, Visual Studio Code, and more. TabTab It also has a powerful search feature that allows users to search by app name, window title, and tab title. Rated highly by users for its beautiful packaging, compact local design, optimized hotkeys, and lightning-fast performance, TabTab is considered an indispensable productivity tool on the Mac. Early adopters lauded this as a way for Apple to navigate its tags, praising its smooth, visually pleasing interface and positive response from developers.

item.title: PDF Buddy 1.3
item.description:
PDF Merge Batch Tool

PDF Buddy is a PDF processing tool for Mac, iPhone, and iPad that combines documents, trims, compresses, deletes sensitive information, arranges pages, stamps, and adds watermarks in a single export, reducing the need to switch between tools and save files repeatedly. All processing is done locally, no documents are uploaded, and the original files are left unchanged. The software will re-encode the image while preserving the text and line graphics, so that the compressed document remains clear and the text can still be selected; the trimming function can identify the content boundaries of each page, and truly remove the excess margin area in the exported file. For privacy data, it supports finding mailboxes, bank card numbers, social security numbers, and faces on the device side, and removing sensitive content through page burning to avoid the problem of selecting the underlying text after only covering it with a black box. Users can also set Bates numbers that are incremented continuously across split files, header footers with date and file name variables, and text or image watermarks. The result preview uses the same processing flow as the actual export, which makes it easy to check the cutting, typesetting, and scrubbing effects before sending. The mobile side also provides the same task switch, which supports importing and sharing documents from the file, mail, or sharing menu.

item.title: AppHub 5.1.0
item.description:
macOS Launchpad Alternative

AppHub is an advanced Launchpad alternative for macOS for those who miss the classic Launchpad experience and want to manage their apps with a visual grid. It provides a look and feel close to Apple Launchpad, quickly browsing, organizing, and launching apps, supporting folders, drag-and-drop sorting, hiding infrequent apps, blank placeholders, custom icon sizes and mesh ratios, and the ability to import layouts from the original Launchpad. The software supports trackpad gestures, hot corners, keyboard navigation, and shortcuts, can be displayed in the Dock, menu bar, or completely hidden, and is compatible with light and dark modes, multilingual app names, external displays, and Liquid Glass background effects. AppHub also allows quick access to app and folder options via a right-click menu, moves windows and resizes them in compact mode, and deletes apps with macOS security for familiar touch and more flexible personalization.

item.title: FilePane 2.0.15
item.description:
macOS drag-and-drop file management tool

FilePane is a drag-and-drop file management and content processing tool for macOS that automatically provides matching shortcuts by identifying file, folder, picture, text, audio, video, and PDF content types, so you don't have to switch between multiple apps to move, copy, edit, convert, and share. Users can directly drag items into a concise dashboard to quickly crop, rotate, scale, compress, and annotate images, and convert between PNG, JPEG, TIFF, BMP, WebP, HEIC, AVIF, and PDF formats. For audio and video content, you can also complete trimming, segmentation, and metadata cleaning. The software supports favorite directories, organizing your desktop and scattered files in fewer steps, and copying file sizes or paths to the clipboard. The Text tool is able to count the number of words and characters in the selection, convert TXT, RTF, and images to PDF, and create folders, text, Excel, or Word documents as needed. FilePane 2. 0 Brings a redesigned interface with the choice of light, dark or follow system appearance, taking into account both operational efficiency and visual consistency;

item.title: Core Tunnel 5.2
item.description:
OpenSSH Tunnel Management Tool

Core Tunnel is an SSH tunnel management tool for macOS that is compatible with OpenSSH to help developers, operators, and remote office users centrally establish, monitor, and maintain port forwarding connections. The software supports local port forwarding, remote port forwarding, and dynamic port forwarding, and can use common capabilities such as proxy jumping, SSH certificates, and proxy forwarding, and can adapt to scenarios such as intranet access, remote debugging, database connection, and security proxy. Tightly integrated with the macOS keychain, it securely stores the passphrases needed to connect, reducing the need to repeatedly enter sensitive credentials. The Advanced Options Editor supports configuring SSH directives for different hosts and instantly explains the meaning of parameters with contextual help. When a network outage is encountered or the Mac recovers from sleep, the automatic reconnection mechanism attempts to recover the existing tunnel. Users can also view status and control connections directly from the menu bar icons without leaving the current working window.

item.title: CamLoop 1.2.13
item.description:
macOS Virtual Camera

CamLoop is a macOS menu bar virtual camera tool that loops pre-recorded personal clips into video conferencing, allowing users to leave their seats briefly while still viewing the camera. The software is compatible with applications such as Zoom, Google Meet, Slack, Microsoft Teams, FaceTime, and OBS that support camera selection. After selecting CamLoop in the meeting, you can switch between loop clips and real-time screens through the menu. The Pro version also supports custom global shortcuts. The first frame fragment at the time of recording helps to align the pose. When returning to the live broadcast, it will wait for a clear and normally exposed picture to switch, reducing dark frames and sudden jumping. The loop includes forward and backward playback, as well as the Pro version's analog network latency and local AI complementary frame connection; the Pro version also provides real-time freezing, catoning, low bitrate effects, unlimited fragment management, and virtual camera renaming. The video is saved locally on the Mac, not uploaded to the cloud, the software does not record or take over the audio, and voice communication in the meeting can continue.

item.title: Maestri 0.58.0
item.description:
Agent coding works together

Maestri is a native AI coding agent orchestration workbench for macOS Apple Silicon that manages multiple terminals, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, or plain shells in one infinite canvas. Developers can freely pan, scale, group, and connect agents on the canvas, allowing different agents to interact, delegate tasks, ask questions, and hand off work directly through the terminal, reducing context loss caused by window switching. It provides hand-drawn sketches, sticky notes, reusable characters, timing prompts, embedded browser Portals, project editor jumps, and independent Floors workspace clones for multi-branch debugging, code review, automated testing, and multi-agent collaboration. The built-in Ombro local AI companion assistant monitors agent progress, summarizes results, and prompts for the next step. Data, notes, and configurations are kept natively, built with Swift, SwiftUI, AppKit, and Metal, bringing a smooth, private, and close to macOS development experience.

item.title: SupaSidebar 1.6.0
item.description:
Tools for integrating multiple browser tags and data

SupaSidebar is a menu bar app designed for Mac that provides an Arc-like sidebar experience that makes it easy to save links, files, and folders so users can access them with just a tap.
